async def receive_message(websocket):

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_broadcast_reaches_all_clients_with_wire_format(server):
    first = await websockets.connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{server.port}")
    second = await websockets.connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{server.port}")
    try:
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        assert server.client_count == 2
        await first.send(json.dumps({"type": "broadcast", "payload": {"text": "hello"}}))
        messages = await asyncio.gather(receive_message(first), receive_message(second))
        assert all(message["type"] == "broadcast" for message in messages)
        assert all(message["payload"] == {"text": "hello"} for message in messages)
        assert all(isinstance(message["timestamp"], str) for message in messages)
    finally:
        await first.close()
        await second.close()

async def test_direct_message_only_reaches_target(server):
    first = await websockets.connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{server.port}")
    second = await websockets.connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{server.port}")
    try:
        for _ in range(10):

class WebSocketTransport(BaseTransport):
    """WebSocket implementation of the notification transport contract."""

    def __init__(self, server: "NotificationServer | None" = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(server)
        self._server: Any = None

    async def start(self) -> None:
        assert self.server is not None
        self._server = await websockets.serve(
            self._handle_connection,
            self.server.host,
            self.server.port,
            process_request=self.server._process_request,
        )
        self.server.port = self._server.sockets[0].getsockname()[1]

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        if self._server is not None:
            self._server.close()
            await self._server.wait_closed()
            self._server = None

    async def on_connect(self, client_id: str, client: ServerConnection) -> None:
        return None

    async def on_disconnect(self, client_id: str, client: ServerConnection) -> None:
        return None

    async def send_message(self, client: ServerConnection, message: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        await client.send(json.dumps(message))

    async def broadcast(self, clients: Iterable[ServerConnection], message: dict[str, Any]) -> list[ServerConnection]:
        client_list = list(clients)
        results = await asyncio.gather(
            *(self.send_message(client, message) for client in client_list),
            return_exceptions=True,
        )
        return [client for client, result in zip(client_list, results) if isinstance(result, Exception)]

    async def _handle_connection(self, websocket: ServerConnection) -> None:
        assert self.server is not None
        query = parse_qs(urlsplit(websocket.request.path).query)
        client_id = query.get("client_id", [str(uuid.uuid4())])[0]
        await self.server._on_connect(client_id, websocket)
        await self.on_connect(client_id, websocket)
        try:
            async for raw_message in websocket:
                await self.server._handle_message(raw_message, client_id)

            pass
        finally:
            await self.on_disconnect(client_id, websocket)

        self.database_url = database_url or os.getenv("DATABASE_URL", ":memory:")

        self.channels: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
        self._client_channels: dict[str, set[str]] = {}

        self._redis: redis.Redis | None = None

        self.transport = transport or self._transport_from_config()
        self.transport.attach(self)

    def _transport_from_config() -> BaseTransport:
        transport_name = os.getenv("TRANSPORT", "websocket").strip().lower()
        if transport_name in {"websocket", "websockets", "ws"}:
            return WebSocketTransport()
        raise ValueError(f"unsupported transport: {transport_name}")

    def client_count(self) -> int:
        return len(self.clients)

        await self.store.start()
